items.explanation: Lubić takes the accusative. Feminine nouns change -a to -ę: muzykę.
optionNotes: Nominative: the dictionary form, used for the subject.
Instrumental (-ą), used after być and z.

items.explanation: Masculine nouns for people and animals take -a in the accusative: brata.
optionNotes: Nominative. English does not change the noun here, Polish does.
Instrumental, as in Jestem bratem Anny.

items.explanation: Telefon is a masculine thing, so nothing changes: nowy telefon.
optionNotes: -ego is for masculine people and animals: nowego kolegę.

items.explanation: Both words change: the adjective takes -ą and the noun takes -ę.
optionNotes: This is the nominative; the object needs the accusative.
